description: One-click high-precision image background removal powered by local native PyTorch RMBG-1.4 model. Outputs clean transparent RGBA PNG (Base64). Completely standalone, zero ComfyUI dependency. Charges 0.01 USDC via x402 on Base Mainnet or eligible points. Supply payer_address. For redemption pass invoice_id and signature in _meta.x402/payment, with tx_hash for on-chain payment or method=points where supported. Settlement errors set isError and _meta.x402/payment-error.status_code; 503 indicates admission unavailable, while a 409 uncertain outcome must not be automatically retried.

add_background.description: Optional background replacement color ('none' for transparent PNG)

image.description: Image data as Base64 string (data:image/png;base64,...) or public HTTP/HTTPS image URL

payer_address.description: Payer wallet for invoice creation and redemption

name: remove_image_background
